name: Sky Access Construction Equipment & Mach
headline: BOOM LIFT, SCISSOR LIFT & MOBILE CRANE RENTAL IN DUBAI
lede: Sky Access provides trusted boom lift, scissor lift, and mobile crane rentals in Dubai and across the UAE. Contact us for heavy machinery hire.
about: Based in Al Qusais 1st Industrial Area, Dubai, we have built a fleet of heavy access machinery and the operational infrastructure to deploy it fast — boom lifts, scissor lifts, spider lifts, truck mounted boom lifts and mobile cranes, with daily hire starting from AED 450. Our clients include contractors and developers across Dubai, Sharjah, Abu Dhabi and Ajman.

Sky Access Transport LLC provides boom lift rental (10m–43m), scissor lift rental (10m–18m electric & diesel), truck mounted boom lift rental (up to 45m), and mobile crane rental (50T–130T) in Dubai and across the UAE. Located in Al Qusais 1st Industrial Area, Dubai.
